title: Reintroducing Nike Tech: Sportswear Innovation Engineered to Protect In Style
summary: Nike Tech has evolved from a single iconic fleece franchise into a year-round range of purpose-built apparel innovations, with each piece designed to solve a specific need for the everyday athlete, season after season.
body_markdown:
For the modern athlete*, no two days are the same.


A clear morning can turn into a downpour. Cold commutes can give way to warm afternoons. Movement shifts between travel, work and sport, often without time to stop and change.


Nike Tech is designed for this reality.


Reintroduced as a purpose-built wardrobe for every season, Nike Tech is built on a fabric-first design approach that begins with the conditions athletes face, meeting every moment with distinct material solutions tailored to their exact needs. That means protection where it’s required, breathability and flexibility where movement demands it, and adaptable designs that are easy to layer and wear throughout the day.


By balancing performance, protection and comfort, Nike Tech gives athletes a responsive uniform designed to move fluidly through every moment of the day, in every season of life.


"This new collection goes way beyond fleece,” says Greg Nolley, Senior Manager, Men’s Sportswear Apparel. “With Nike Tech, we’ve created a complete wardrobe of dress that’s designed to work together — from how a T-shirt layers under a jacket to how different fabrics and textures interact. It is both a head-to-toe proposition and a true inside-out layering system, fueled by Nike innovation in service of the athlete."


**An Innovative, Purpose-Built Wardrobe**


At the forefront of the collection is **Nike Tech SF3** , the franchise’s next generation of material innovation and its most advanced expression of weather protection.


Engineered to keep athletes moving when the forecast changes, SF3 leverages recycled materials, fully sealed seams and advanced manufacturing techniques to create a waterproof construction that locks out water without sacrificing airflow.


The distinctive fabric softens over time, creating rainwear that becomes more personal the longer it’s worn.


“For Nike Tech SF3, the goal was almost a redefinition of outerwear,” says Nolley. “Athletes who have worn it say it’s unlike anything they’ve ever experienced before. The interior speaks to a high level of performance, while the outer shell offers everything you need for torrential downpours. It’s an incredibly lightweight protective layer.”


When temperatures fall, the new full-zip **Nike Tech Boreas** pairs high-pile fleece with water-repellent panels to deliver warmth and protection in unpredictable conditions. An oversize fit is designed to move with the body, while darted zip pockets provide secure storage for essentials on the go.


**Nike Tech Fleece** continues to provide the lightweight warmth that established Nike Tech as an icon. Premium fleece, smooth on both sides, offers warmth without the weight, while a relaxed shape supports easy layering. Reflective Bemis tape along the chest and seams adds visibility through considered detailing.


For warmer conditions, **Nike Tech Helios** delivers lightweight breathability and micro-ventilation, while **Nike Tech Shori** combines cooling comfort and stretch with the clean, modern visual language of Nike Tech. **Nike Tech Woven** further broadens the system of dress, completing a portfolio designed to move across climates without skipping a beat.


Each platform shares a consistent design philosophy: solve a real athlete need through material innovation, then make the solution easy to wear, serving as a physical expression of Nike’s unmatched ability to connect sport and innovation to everyday life.


The new Nike Tech collection will be available November 5 at[nike.com](https://www.nike.com/) and select retail locations.


**If you have a body, you are an athlete.*
